title: Inadequate Lighting in Camp Areas
description: Certain sections of the camp lack adequate lighting during the night, increasing the risk of trips, falls, and injuries, particularly due to exposed tree stumps and uneven terrain.
immediate action taken: Install adequate lighting in all poorly lit areas of the camp to ensure safe movement during nighttime. Remove or mark hazards such as tree stumps, and conduct regular checks to ensure all lighting systems are functional.

title: Improper Disposal of Cigarette Butts
description: Cigarette butts were found discarded in front of and behind tents, indicating that some employees are not using designated smoking areas.
immediate action taken: Reinforce the use of designated smoking areas through continuous awareness and toolbox talks. Provide clearly marked disposal bins in smoking zones and enforce compliance through supervision and routine inspections.

title: Poor Housekeeping Between Tents
description: Safety boots and general waste (plastic pipes) were found scattered between tents. This messy condition can attract dangerous creatures and provide hiding places, especially during colder seasons. The area was cleaned and items properly arranged
immediate action taken:
Maintain strict housekeeping standards by ensuring all personal items are stored appropriately and waste is disposed of in designated areas. 
Assigned responsibility for cleanliness and conduct regular inspections to prevent recurrence.

title: Tents Left Open (Pest/Animal Intrusion Risk)
description: Three (3) tents were found with door zips left open in the absence of occupants, creating easy access for snakes, scorpions, and other dangerous creatures. The tents were closed during the inspection.
immediate action taken:
Ensure all tent occupants keep entrances fully closed when not in use. 
Conduct awareness discussions with the affected occupants to reinforce the importance of this control measure. Include this in routine inspections to ensure ongoing compliance.

title: Damaged Kitchen Storage Shelves
description: The shelves in the kitchen storage area are broken and in poor condition.
immediate action taken:
Assigned the maintenance team to repair or replace the damaged shelves without delay. 
Ensure that shelving units are structurally sound and capable of supporting the intended load. 
Redistribute stored items to reduce excessive weight on compromised shelves until repairs are completed. 
Implemented routine inspections of storage infrastructure to identify and address defects promptly, ensuring continued safety and proper food storage conditions.

title: Water Filters
description: Water filters require frequent servicing due to high levels of silt from the drying borehole, which can affect water quality.
immediate action taken: Implement regular monitoring and servicing of water filters, increase replacement frequency, and consider installing pre-filtration systems to manage sediment levels. Maintain service records.

title: Unsecured Gas Pipes
description: Gas pipes connecting cylinders to the stove are not properly secured, increasing the risk of leaks and accidents.
immediate action taken: Secure all gas pipes using appropriate clamps or brackets, inspect regularly for wear or leaks, and ensure compliance with gas safety standards.

title: No Shade/Protection Over Sink Area
description: The sink area is exposed, lacking shade and protection from flies, affecting user comfort and hygiene.
immediate action taken: Install a shade net or covering over the sink area to provide protection from sun and to help reduce fly presence.

title: Sink Area Without Concrete Slab
description: The sink area lacks a concrete slab, resulting in poor hygiene, mud accumulation, and unstable footing.
immediate action taken: Construct a concrete slab with proper slope to improve drainage, hygiene, and stability of the work area.

title: Tripping Hazard – Exposed Electrical Cable
description: An exposed electrical cable is temporarily covered by a block, which creates a tripping hazard and unsafe condition.
immediate action taken: Remove the block and properly bury or reroute the cable through protective conduit. Ensure all cables are safely managed and eliminate temporary fixes.

title: Missing Fire Extinguisher Signage
description: The fire extinguisher in the kitchen area does not have proper signage, making it less visible during emergencies.
immediate action taken: Install compliant and clearly visible fire extinguisher signage and include this in regular safety inspections.

title: Non-Functional Fluorescent Lights
description: Two fluorescent light bulbs in the kitchen are not functioning, leading to inadequate lighting conditions.
immediate action taken: Replace the faulty bulbs immediately and implement a routine inspection schedule to maintain adequate lighting levels.

title: Broken Cupboard Door
description: A cupboard door in the kitchen is broken, creating a risk of injury due to sharp edges or instability.
immediate action taken: Repair or replace the cupboard door promptly. Inspect all storage units to ensure they are safe and fit for use.

title: Broken Chair
description:
A broken chair was identified in the kitchen area, posing a potential risk of injury to users due to its unstable condition. 
The chair has already been removed from the area to prevent use.
immediate action taken:
Ensure the broken chair is removed from service immediately
Dispose of or repair damaged furniture promptly.
Conduct routine inspections of kitchen furniture.

title: Flies in Kitchen
description: A significant presence of flies was observed in the kitchen area, creating an unhygienic environment and increasing the risk of food contamination.
immediate action taken:
Improve general kitchen hygiene and waste management.
Ensure food items are always covered and stored properly

title: Unauthorized Access
description: The distribution board (DB) box located near the kitchen is not barricaded or secured, allowing for potential unauthorized access. This condition presents a significant electrical hazard to personnel, including risk of electric shock or accidental contact with live components
immediate action taken:
Install a secure barricade or lockable enclosure around the DB box.
Place warning signage indicating “Authorized Personnel Only.”
Conduct regular inspections to ensure the barricade remains intact.

title: Poor Housekeeping in Storage Tent
description: Fuel materials, including diesel containers and coal, were found stored in a disorganized manner within the storage area. This condition increases the risk of fire, spills, and unsafe handling practices.
immediate action taken:
Immediately reorganize the storage tent to ensure safe and orderly arrangement of materials.
Segregate flammable substances (diesel, coal) from other items and store them in designated areas.
Ensure proper ventilation within the storage tent.
Conduct regular inspections to maintain compliance with safety standards.

title: Inadequate Water Drainage
description: The washing/kitchen area has inadequate water drainage due to insufficient slope, resulting in stagnant water accumulation. This creates an unhygienic environment, produces unpleasant odors, and promotes the breeding of mosquitoes and flies, increasing potential health risks.
immediate action taken:
Regrade the washing area to create adequate slope for proper water flow.
Install suitable drainage channels or soak-away systems.
Regularly remove stagnant water and disinfect affected areas.
